name: dmengine-fumo-download-update
description: Mode C combined FUMO command: the mock sends Exec on ./ManagedObjects/FUMO/DownloadAndUpdate. The engine performs the authenticated DD/DP download, sets update-progressing (state 60) and hands event 77 with /update//lab-fumo to the OEM handler. The lab OEM handler then reports update result 200; the engine triggers the DM report session, sets state 90 and returns to idle. This proves the engine-side update result path with a lab-supplied result, not a physical install.
